profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.summary: After finishing an excellent bootcamp program several years ago with Awesome Inc, I got my first taste of Software Development. Ever since, I've loved the work, loved the people, and loved the journey that my career has taken me. With my new position at JP Morgan Chase, that journey is continuing, and I am very excited to work with some of the brightest and most talented developers I have ever met.

positions.description:
- Supported the JASK 2019 Cultural Festival
- Managed media for advertising with both iHeart radio and The Bull 98.3. Signed sponsors and organized local restaurants, vendors and demonstrations throughout the festival. 
- Provided organizational and logistical support for annual Shinnenkai at the Governor's Mansion in Frankfort with KY officials and CEOs of Japanese owned organizations.  
- Marketed to and collaborated with Kentucky high schools to promote an international cultural exchange with consulate in Japan
